integrity: Proof uses normal forms for both products, unique intrinsic flags, incidence geometry and a polynomial degeneration; exact small-field arithmetic check is supplementary, not a proof for infinite fields.
scientific_limitations: Reduced variety only; exact labelled finite-field counts, not orbit counts; nilpotent three-dimensional LSDA only. Priority with unindexed geometric classification literature cannot be fully excluded.
title: Two components of the three-dimensional nilpotent left-symmetric dialgebra variety
